notes.child_name: No child is named on this document (payment-history statement between payor and recipient only).
notes.payment_amount: Uses 'Monto ordenado (actual)' ($450.00/week, the current-support order amount), not 'Monto total de la orden (actual + atrasos)' ($550.00/week, which adds the $100/week arrears payment) - consistent with how this field is read on the other two child-support documents. LLM's value (550.00) is the combined total, not the ordered current-support amount.
notes.effective_start_date/order_date: Printed as '05/01/2021', which is ambiguous in isolation - but this document is unambiguously DD/MM/YYYY elsewhere: 'Fecha de nacimiento: 17/03/1990' (day 17 can't be a month), and every day-unambiguous date in the 8-row payment history table (19/07/2026, 30/08/2026, etc.) reads day-first too. So '05/01/2021' resolves to January 5, 2021, not May 1. BDA's '2021-05-01' assumes MM/DD/YYYY and is wrong; LLM's '2021-01-05' correctly applied the document's day-first convention.
